tool: Built-in imagegen pose studies. Final native art redrawn on the game grid.

tiers.1: Use case: stylized-concept. Midlife Survivors Tier 1 chest asset pose study. Exactly two side-by-side cells, left closed, right open, same stationary floor footprint, same scale and top-down 3/4 game angle. a cream Employee Appreciation gift box with a muted teal ribbon and a comically drooping curled bow; hinged gift lid; blank cream gift tag for native lettering. Keep body base level and its center precisely consistent. Pixel artwork drawn on an implied 96x96 grid, hard square pixels, one-pixel deep navy outline, highlights upper left, small solid shade clusters. Use #171C35, #303750, #3E7775, #83A89A, #F2D7A1, #EF9347 and a restrained warm gold ramp. The reward should read at 96px and at 48px. Genuine transparent background, no shadows on background, no sparkles, no blur, no borders, no extra objects, no lettering. The reference atlas is a pixel density and palette reference only.
